name: the same image follows across phone and browser
looks: A phone showing the generated scene as its lock screen sits beside a browser window open to the same product's web app, the identical image now sitting inside a small preview card in the page, both devices held steady over the same swirling background.
build: Fixed device frame positions side by side; each screen's content is a layer inside its own mask; a slow camera dolly (translateX, 15-20px/s) supplies motion even though the devices don't move relative to each other, same mechanic as device-row-cross-fade.
sound: A soft whoosh under the camera drift.
prompt: Hold a phone and a browser window side by side, both carrying the same generated image in their own natural context, lock screen and web app, with a slow camera drift supplying the only motion, to show one output following the user everywhere.
